CONTEXT: Acme Corp account_id=acme-88. Destructive ops require human approval. Email drafting is generative. There is also Acme Retail (account_id=acme-retail-12) — do not confuse them.

destructive_targets.instructions: Each data target the user wants destroyed, as phrased.

account_name.instructions: The customer or account name named for destruction.

account_id_if_stated.instructions: Any explicit account id in the user message; null if the user did not state one.

ambiguous_identity.instructions: Whether more than one similar account exists in context that could be confused: yes or no, plus the names.

also_requested.instructions: Non-destructive additional requests in the same message.

irreversible.instructions: yes if destruction is permanent, no otherwise.
